title.narrative: FUNGUO Innovation Programme-UNDP-TZA-00125729

description.narrative: The ultimate aim of the FUNGUO Innovation Programme is to increase the number of successfully scaled innovation impact ventures to contribute to the national development goals and the SDGs in Tanzania. This is being achieved through the programme’s contribution in addressing the stumbling blocks and gaps in the innovation ecosystem that hinder innovative impact ventures from scaling, while promoting an environment that promotes innovation for development and empowers innovators, entrepreneurs, a
capital of a political entity

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

title.narrative: Activity web page

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

comment.narrative: The project was launched in April 2021, so the baseline for all output indicators in 2021 is zero.

- hire the Funguo Team - set up the Funguo Office - start the SIP - undertake the HDIF impact assesment - sign donor financing - support events in the innovation ecosystem including Innovation Week and MAKISATU - Take over the HDIF Digital Assets. - see the ProDoc for the full results matrix

- 4 staff hired + 1 intern - office identified and letter of intention to rent after renovation signed. Works expected to be completed in 2021 for move in to office January 2022. - SIP started with discussions on investors coming to Tanzania, commercialisation of university projects, and digtial economy through the lense of crowd fudning with CMSA. - The HDIF Impact Assesment was contracted, but the contract is being terminated because of poor quality by the company. - MAKISATU and Innovation Week were given technical and financial support. - 6 additional innovation ecosystem events were supported. - HDIF digital assests were handed over and Funguo branding and accounts set up.
